# MP Transparency Tracker

> Open-data transparency rankings for all 540 Lok Sabha MPs (India). Each MP is scored 0-100 across 8 weighted dimensions: MPLADS fund use (20%), criminal record disclosures (20%), asset declarations (15%), parliament attendance (15%), participation (10%), legislative activity (10%), committees (5%), public accessibility (5%). Scores are scrutiny aids backed by cited public sources — not legal conclusions.

Every MP page below links to a full markdown report with source citations.

## Data access

- MP name/constituency/party → URL resolver (JSON): https://neta-gym.github.io/mp-transparency-tracker/search-index.json
- Per-MP machine-readable scores: https://neta-gym.github.io/mp-transparency-tracker/data/{{state-slug}}/scores/{{mp-slug}}.json
- Per-MP full markdown report: linked per MP below, or https://neta-gym.github.io/mp-transparency-tracker/data/{{state-slug}}/reports/{{mp-slug}}.md
- National leaderboard (JSON): https://neta-gym.github.io/mp-transparency-tracker/data/national/leaderboard/latest.json
- State leaderboards (JSON): https://neta-gym.github.io/mp-transparency-tracker/data/{{state-slug}}/leaderboard/latest.json

## Methodology

- Scoring methodology and interpretation notes: https://neta-gym.github.io/mp-transparency-tracker/national
